response.justification: Bogdan has strong full-stack engineering experience, entrepreneurial initiative with GISCollective, and exposure to AI-agent infrastructure, but lacks clear evidence of AI/ML product leadership, cloud platform strategy depth, or director-level impact required for this role, despite 15+ years of experience.
strengths: Demonstrated entrepreneurial initiative with open-source AI-adjacent GIS platform used by NGOs
Extensive full-stack experience across languages, cloud tools (AWS CDK, Docker, Kubernetes), and real-time systems
Proven technical leadership through workshops, open-source contributions, and cross-functional engineering
concerns: No clear evidence of building or leading AI/ML products or platforms as required
Limited visibility into cloud architecture strategy or customer-facing AI advisory experience
Master's/PhD in AI missing; AI exposure appears incidental rather than specialized
